title: Arxo registry request
description: A request by an external author to add released packages to the public Arxo registry. The request names the files of `law pack` artifacts by sha256 and size; the bytes themselves are assets of a GitHub Release in the author's public repository. A maintainer approves exactly the hashes named here; after acceptance the bytes are copied under Arxo's control and published by the registry job.
$comment: DECISION-0476 §3 п. 2; строки packages — те же, что пишет law publish --candidate (arxo.registry-candidate/1, DECISION-0376). Печатает law publish --request.

source.description: Where the bytes are: the author's public GitHub repository, the Release tag carrying the assets and the commit the tag points to. The commit records provenance; the bytes are checked by sha256 only.

release.description: Tag of the Release whose assets are the files listed in packages.

commit.description: Commit the release tag points to.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or expression of the published packages. A request without a license is not accepted.

packages.description: One row per file of every artifact in the request, release.json included. Several packages may travel together when one depends on another.

FileRow.description: A file of a packed release.

file.description: Release asset name: a single file name, <name>-<version>.<path with dots>.

path.description: Relative path of the file inside the packed artifact; no absolute paths and no `..` segments.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file.
